svg.aria-label: Persian voice assistant architecture. Edge band: a Raspberry Pi 3 with microphone, wake-word detector, and a recorder paired with a concurrent silence detector that stops it. The gated audio clip is the only thing that leaves the house. Cloud band: four services — Speech-to-Action orchestrating Speech-to-Text, a per-user text classifier, and a model registry. The cloud returns an action identifier, which the hub publishes on the D-Bus message bus, where local subscribers act on it.
